notes.subject: תשאות סכתו
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS 'noise/thunderings of his pavilion' (God's tent) vs YLT reading the crashing as belonging to the cloud-structure itself; Hebrew is ambiguous.

notes.subject: verse 29
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question on whether anyone can understand God's cloud-workings — deliberately unanswerable.
